To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
N-allyl amides are useful synthetic intermediates for the construction of a pyrrolizin-2-one core.
the nucleophilic addition reaction of a vinyl Gringard reagent/elimination sequence has been applied for pyrrolizinonone derivatives.

the sequential transformations of N-allyl-2-pyrrolidinone derivatives via nucleophilic additions of vinyl Grignard compounds, ring-closing metathesis (RCM) reactions, and elimination reactions afforded pyrrolizidinone and pyrrolizin-2-one derivatives in good yields.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new synthetic routes to biologically active pyrrolizinon derivatives via sequential transformations.
the synthesis of pyrrolidinone derivatives via the sequential transformations of cyclic N-allyl amides and imides.
the development of new synthetic methodologies for the construction of biologically important nitrogen heterocyclic compounds.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the reaction of the N-allyl cyclic imides with Grignard reagents and the subsequent RCM reaction provides pyrrolizidinone derivatives in good yields and the reaction conditions can be optimized for the synthesis of the target compounds in a single step.
the reaction conditions are not suitable for the preparation of 2,3-dihydroxy-4,5-dihydropyrrolizinone derivatives.
the present study has provided a new synthetic method for the preparation of various pyrrolizinonones.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a novel synthetic route for the preparation of the pyrrolizin-2-one ring system.
the nucleophilic addition/RCM/ elimination sequence can be applied to the synthesis of pyrrolidines, pyrrolidinones, and pyrrolizin-3-ones.
the pyrrolizin-2-one ring system is a privileged structure that is present in many bioactive molecules.
The main takeaway from our work is that
N-allyl pyridones and imides are versatile starting materials for the synthesis of pyrrolidinone and pyrrolizinine derivatives.
N-allyl cyclic imides are versatile starting materials for the preparation of various heterocyclic compounds.
the N-allyl amide is not a good substrate for this transformation.
